target.name: Voimatalo
target.selection_reason: A bounded office case within the current ordinary office/accommodation/commercial scope. Its public footprint is wholly inside the acquired tile and its use is confirmed independently of its appearance.

public_sources.facts_used: Voimatalo at Malminrinne 3 / Malminkatu 16; current use office; eight storeys with six repeating office floors, a recessed top floor, and street-level commercial space.
Building footprint, Voimatalo name, Malminrinne 3 address, building=office, building:levels=7 and roof:levels=1.
The mesh supports measurements in ETRS-GK25/N2000 and City of Helsinki reports its vertices within about 20 cm of real positions.
2017 OBJ uses metres, north +Y/east +X, and city-model local origin EPSG:3879 easting 25490000, northing 6668000.

source_tile.registration_basis: The SUM tile coordinates and 250 m bounds align with the documented Helsinki city-model local grid. Transforming the public footprint through EPSG:3879 and subtracting the documented city origin places it on the visible Voimatalo facade. This cross-source registration is an inference checked by overlay, not metadata embedded in the sanitised GLB.

footprint.target_crs: Helsinki city-model local XY metres = EPSG:3879 minus (25490000, 6668000)

crop.reason: The public footprint and photogrammetry mesh are independent sources with approximately decimetre registration uncertainty. A 0.35 m buffer keeps facade triangles at the boundary while limiting the retained ground/context strip. No semantic labels select faces.

unknown_or_inferred: which historic repeating-floor details remain current
